There is not one revenue figure for the period ending 2007-09-29 in this evidence base, but two, and ST-EVA has not selected between them. Both are held for AAPL, for the same period 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29 (as_of 2007-09-29), both in USD reported currency, and both trace to the same source document.

Chain A: observation obsarch_ddb4af888ab3c6be910c0f9e, value 24,006,000,000 USD, evidence state SOURCE_REPORTED (reason code SOURCE_STATED_VALUE), validation UNVERIFIABLE with no cross-checks recorded. Its source fact is sfid_b5229f1711c68622f937916d70285775, scoped as one raw fact inside one source document. Its source document is doc_24e188322f7c7d6939f9dc79, content hash sha256:8b37365a7f187479d40d872ed51551ca40a3981268248b91ba2643cbfb152591, an SEC_COMPANY_CONCEPT JSON document at https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000320193/us-gaap/SalesRevenueNet.json (HTTP 200, 31,766 bytes, gzip, content available, fetched 2026-09-29). Accession 0001193125-09-214859, form 10-K, provider SecEdgar, source type REGULATORY_FILING. Concept us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet, mapped to the metric revenue as PARTIAL, not EXACT, with the mapping window effective 2007-09-29 to 2018-06-30 and the series marked as not continuing. Availability: available_at 2009-10-27T00:00:00+00:00 on an ACCEPTANCE_DATETIME basis, class SOURCE_DECLARED, knowable_at the same instant.

Chain B: observation obsarch_6383b6a9892d72ff26aab02a, value 24,578,000,000 USD, also SOURCE_REPORTED and also UNVERIFIABLE with no cross-checks. Its source fact is sfid_52493188959d0d442076337871e8951b. It carries the same source document, doc_24e188322f7c7d6939f9dc79 with the same content hash and URI, but a different accession, 0001193125-10-012091, form 10-K/A. Same concept us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet, same PARTIAL mapping and same mapping window. Availability: available_at 2010-01-25T00:00:00+00:00, ACCEPTANCE_DATETIME, SOURCE_DECLARED, knowable_at the same instant.

The ambiguity is recorded on both observations: reason MULTIPLE_FILINGS, same measure established, two filings and two distinct values, resolution NO_WINNER_SELECTED, with the explicit note that the figures may be a restatement, a re-filing or two different periods of coverage and that the evidence held does not establish which filing was meant. The two figures differ by 572,000,000 USD. Issuer adoption of us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet by AAPL (asset_1eb44d625271a4eb7501) is observed to run from 2007-09-29 to 2018-06-30 over 210 facts in 40 filings. Both observations are also archived: retrieved_at and first_archived_at 2026-09-29T16:47:58Z. I did not select either figure as the answer and did not compute anything; derived_refs is empty.
uncertainties: The evidence does not settle which filing governs the period ending 2007-09-29: ST-EVA records NO_WINNER_SELECTED between 24,006,000,000 (accession 0001193125-09-214859, 10-K) and 24,578,000,000 (accession 0001193125-10-012091, 10-K/A), and the record does not state whether the second is a restatement, a re-filing or a different period of coverage.

Both observations are UNVERIFIABLE: the cross-check register is empty for each, and the stated reason is that a single official source cannot cross-validate itself. Agreement between the two is therefore not established and correctness is not established.

The source concept is us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet, mapped to the metric revenue as PARTIAL rather than EXACT, with the series marked not continuing and a CONCEPT_MAPPING_BREAK recorded for 2007-09-29 to 2018-06-30 (explanation NOT_EXPLAINED_BY_ST_EVA), plus a second break for us-gaap:Revenues from 2016-09-24. The figure is not an exact expression of the metric as the metric is defined.

The source fact ids sfid_b5229f1711c68622f937916d70285775 and sfid_52493188959d0d442076337871e8951b could not themselves be resolved: a lineage lookup on each returned UNAVAILABLE, no observation or derived value with that reference. The fact-level payload is therefore not inspectable here; only the observation-level record and the shared source document metadata are.

The source document payload is not returned by the query surface (content_returned false, content_note says to verify the content hash against a copy already held), so the raw fact inside it was not re-read; both facts point to one and the same document and content hash.

The evidence state explanation field reads us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax while the concept, taxonomy and mapping fields read us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet; the record does not explain the discrepancy.
The metadata on both observations carries fiscal_year 2009 and fiscal_period FY against a period ending 2007-09-29; the record does not reconcile that.
ST-EVA gives no reason for either the value difference or the concept mapping break.
